g.text: Match the system to the decision and its budget
A research workbench, professional workflow and transaction classifier have different acceptance tests.

g.text: Different forms, one discipline: match the data representation, executor and operating budget to the decision.
These are practitioner accounts, not a maturity ranking or causal financial comparison.
Sources: Bridgewater · Coatue · Wells Fargo · Blackstone / Norm.ai | Reviewed October 25, 2026
